abstention: No fabricated numeric prediction/error for unsupported inputs; zero support means undefined metrics
candidate_features: five status-bearing core is only a feasibility proposal; original eight, derived/frequency channels and expanded families need semantic review; no family approved
fair_comparison: Same split IDs, label mask and scenario; report matched common-support errors plus intended-population counts; do not compare disjoint scoring populations as a winner
final_policy: Select/freeze using development only; refit on all development groups; score two reserved groups once after approvals; retain first evaluation and later diagnostic reruns; no retuning
fold_policy: For each outer held-out development experiment, any fitted preprocessing, imputation, scaling, feature/window/freshness/family/component choice and tuning uses only inner grouped folds of outer training groups; refit on outer training groups before scoring; never consult outer labels for choices
primary_ranking_metric: equal-weight mean of experiment MAE in cells/mL
secondary_metrics: signed bias prediction minus observation cells/mL
uncertainty: Development experiment-group resampling only where adequate groups contribute, descriptive small-N limitations; no inferential final-test interval from two groups
window_protocol: Snapshot only in Stages1/2; proposed later windows fixed before scoring or chosen in inner folds with explicit minimum support; rolling features unimplemented
within_experiment_weighting: Pool all scored assays across both reactors; also report each reactor; experiments weighted equally
